# Files that scripts/sync-coding-agent-setup.sh copies into a target repo.
# Format: <mode> <path>   (path = file or directory, relative to repo root)
#   sync  overwrite in the target; generic, changed only in coding-agent-setup
#   seed  copy only when missing; the project fills it in afterwards
# Never listed (project-specific): docs/agents/CURRENT.md, domain.md,
# issue-tracker.md (generated by /setup-matt-pocock-skills), project docs.

sync .claude/skills
sync .agents/skills
sync skills-lock.json
sync .claude/agents/implementer.md
sync .claude/agents/implementer-escalated.md
sync docs/agents/WORKFLOW.md
sync docs/agents/triage-labels.md
sync CLAUDE.md

seed AGENTS.md
seed Makefile
seed .github/workflows/ci.yml
seed .gitattributes
seed .editorconfig
